shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "cat specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && printf '\\n--- DOD ---\\n' && cat .lore/dod.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files | rg '("'^|/)(.*test.*|.*spec.*)$|test-commands.yml'"' | head -100"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files src/orchestration .lore scripts | head -100; printf '\\n--- orchestrator tests ---\\n'; sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; printf '\\n--- implementation ---\\n'; sed -n '110,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; printf '\\n--- test commands ---\\n'; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- git ---\\n'; git status --short --branch; git log -1 --oneline"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.*#|validated by' src specs | head -80; sed -n '1,140p' src/orchestration/toolBudget.test.ts; sed -n '1,180p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; sed -n '1,150p' scripts/lore-run-test.mjs; ls -a | rg 'prettier|jest' "
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'spec:|@spec|specs/.+#' src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -40; cat scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs | head -100; rg -n 'lore_'"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,60p' src/transport/ws/subprotocol.test.ts; rg -n 'specs/.*#[0-9]' --glob '*.test.ts' | head -30; rg -n 'specs/' src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -30"

/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "test: pin onError for non-Error rejections" && git push origin HEAD'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
